summary: Crowd-control-first Bureaucrat implant build. The cluster priority is computed, not remembered: across all 343 Bureaucrat-castable nanos in bureaucrat-nanos.json the cast requirements fall Psychological Modification 234, Time & Space 207, Sensory Improvement 153, Matter Creation 100, Biological Metamorphosis 83, Matter Metamorphosis 1. So PM takes Head shiny AND Ear faded (its two reachable homes), SI takes Eye bright because PM and SI are co-requirements at near-identical values on 124 of those nanos (Empowered Divided Ego 224143 wants PM 2001 / SI 1997), Time & Space takes Right Hand bright and Matter Creation takes Eye faded - the only split possible, because MC and T&S share all three of their homes - BM takes Chest bright + Waist faded for the fear/charm/debuff lines, Nano C. Init takes Chest faded because a calm that lands late does not land at all, Nano Pool takes Chest shiny + Head bright ahead of Body Dev., Psychology takes Ear bright (the Crat is the only class with its own PsychologyBuff line: Authority Figure 30057 +50, Improved Authority Figure 207284 +52), Treatment takes Right Hand faded, and Pistol takes Right Wrist shiny. Matter Metamorphosis gets Left Arm faded and buys exactly ONE nano. Every placement was script-validated against reference/implants.json: 39 placements, all legal for their slot and grade, no cluster used twice in any grade.
_gradeMeaning: shiny = biggest bonus, bright = ~60%, faded = ~40% (reference/implants.json _grades). A skill placed in two implants stacks - here Psychological Modifications (Head shiny + Ear faded), Nano Pool (Chest shiny + Head bright), Biological Metamorphosis (Chest bright + Waist faded), Body Dev. (Waist bright + Legs faded), Dodge-Rng (Legs shiny + Feet bright) and Evade-ClsC (Feet shiny + Legs bright) each get two grades. Because each cluster has exactly one shiny/bright/faded home across all 13 slots, spending a slot's grade on one skill permanently denies it to every other skill whose only remaining home is there. 33 of the 85 clusters in the table are used by this build; the other 52 get nothing, and the ones that matter are named in _coverageSummary and _deviations.
_qualityNote: QL values are the conventional top-tier target for regular (non-Jobe, non-refined) implants; higher QLs exist via refined/Jobe clusters and laddering. AO-Universe's Bureaucrat guide moves the Crat onto symbiants early - 'At level 58 you will benefit alot from Symbiants, especially for your Eye, Head and Right hand' - and names Eye, Head, Ear, Chest and Waist as the most important slots, so this cluster layout is the leveling/twink build and an endgame Crat replaces most of it with CONTROL-unit symbiants (see bureaucrat-symbiants.json). The QLs here are guidance, not values read from item data.
_professionLockNote: No implant in Anarchy Online carries a profession lock. All 44,060 ItemClass-3 implant templates in items.ocp have zero Profession(60) requirements, so any automated 'what can profession 8 equip' sweep reports every implant in the game as Bureaucrat-usable and tells you nothing. Implant applicability is not derivable from item criteria; this file is therefore derived from the cluster-to-slot table plus the Bureaucrat's own IP cost factors and its nanos' cast requirements, and it asserts no profession restriction that the client data does not contain. (CLASS-PROFILE-PLAYBOOK.md section 9b.)

shiny.note: Head is the only shiny home of every nano school, and for a Bureaucrat the contest is decided by counting: PM is a cast requirement on 234 of the Crat's 343 nanos - every one of the 25 calms, 37 charms, 17 roots, 9 fears, 17 debuffs, 13 demotivational and 12 motivational speeches - and it is cost factor 1.0. Its highest requirement is 2001 (Means Test Pet, 258222). Time & Space (207 nanos, cost 1.6) and Sensory Improvement (153, cost 1.0) are the runners-up and are picked up at Right Hand bright and Eye bright instead.

bright.note: Head is Nano Pool's bright home; stacks with the Chest shiny. Cost factor 1.4 and AOWiki's Bureaucrat page is explicit about why: 'Keep this high if you can, more Nano will provide a buffer for when your Calms go awry.' The thin Head-bright list (Dimach 3.0 / Ranged Init. 3.2 / Electrical Engineering 2.4 / Map Navigation 2.0 / Nano Pool 1.4 / Weapon Smithing 2.5) has nothing else a Crat uses.

faded.note: Thin Head-faded list (Trap Disarming 2.4 / Vehicle Air 2.0 / Perception 1.6 / Sense / Tutoring 1.0). Sense is an ABILITY, so it helps meet the QL*2+4 ability requirement on higher-QL implants and Control symbiants, and it feeds Psychology 50% and Pistol 40%. AO-Universe: Strength, Sense and Agility 'are mostly needed to equip Implants, Symbiants and Armor'. Tutoring (cost 1.0) is the cheapest alternative and does nothing in a fight.

build.notes: The core Bureaucrat implant. Spending Head shiny on PM is what denies a cluster to Computer Literacy, Intelligence, Psychic, Max Nano Energy, Nano Programming, Pharma Tech, Poison AC, Ranged Energy and Melee Energy - see _deviations.

shiny.note: The Eye-shiny list (Aimed Shot 4.0 / Vehicle Air 2.0 / Electrical Engineering 2.4 / Map Navigation 2.0 / Rifle 4.0 / Tutoring 1.0) contains nothing a Bureaucrat uses at all. Tutoring is the Crat's joint-cheapest cluster in the game (cost factor 1.0, tied with PM, SI, BM, Nano C. Init, Computer Literacy and Psychology), so it is the pick that costs least to keep at QL 200. This differs from the Doctor build, which takes Electrical Engineering here because EE is 1.6 for a Doctor; for a Crat EE is 2.4.

bright.note: Eye is SI's bright home and, with Head shiny spent on PM, SI's best remaining grade. SI is cost 1.0 and is the SECOND requirement on 124 of the 234 PM nanos at near-identical values - Empowered Divided Ego (224143) PM 2001 / SI 1997; The Voice of God (231010) PM / SI / BM 1500 each; Demotivational Speech: Dead Man Walking (275826) PM 1913 / SI 1913; Greater Corporate Insurance Policy (267605) PM 1901 / SI 1901. Raising PM without SI unlocks none of those, which is why SI beats Nano C. Init, Treatment, Computer Literacy and Intelligence for this cluster.

faded.note: Eye is MC's faded home. MC and Time & Space share ALL THREE homes (Head shiny, Right Hand bright, Eye faded), so a Crat can never implant both at the same grade - and all 65 robot pets require the two at exactly equal values (Corporate Guardian 235386: MC 1227 / T&S 1227; CEO Guardian 273300: MC 1470 / T&S 1470). T&S takes the bright grade because it is on 207 nanos to MC's 100; MC takes this faded one. Pistol and Psychology faded also live here and are picked up at Right Wrist shiny and Ear bright instead.

build.notes: Core caster slot and the most contested bright list in the game (SI, Nano C. Init, Treatment, Computer Literacy, Intelligence, Nano Programming, Pharma Tech, Perception, Chemistry, Quantum FT all live in Eye bright).

shiny.note: The only Ear-shiny cluster in the game. Cost 1.6 for a Bureaucrat (cheaper than the Doctor's 2.4) and near-filler - its one real use is seeing sneaking players in PvP. Keep the QL low if you are short on Treatment.

bright.note: Ear is Psychology's bright home (its shiny home, Head, is spent on PM). This is a genuinely Bureaucrat-specific pick, not filler: Psychology is cost factor 1.0 for a Crat (2.3 for a Doctor, 1.5 for a Soldier), it is the skill the 37 charm nanos are checked against, AOWiki says 'Max this out if you plan on using Charms extensively', and the Bureaucrat is the only profession in the game with its own PsychologyBuff line - Authority Figure (30057, PM/SI 207) gives +50 Psychology and Improved Authority Figure (207284, same requirement) gives +52. Chosen/Faithful Bureaucrat Cloak (219050 / 218970) adds another +60 at QL300.

faded.note: Ear is PM's faded home - the SECOND PM grade, stacking with the Head shiny. Taken over Intelligence and Psychic, which are the only other Crat-relevant clusters in this list (Vehicle Ground / Vehicle Water / Intelligence / Map Navigation / Psychic / PM): an ability only contributes a fraction of a nano skill (PM is roughly 80% Int / 20% Psy), so a PM cluster beats an Int cluster for the skill it is bought for. This choice is what leaves Intelligence and Psychic with no cluster at all - see _deviations.

build.notes: Not a filler slot for a Crat: bright is a real Psychology cluster and faded is the second grade of the class's primary nano school.

shiny.note: Right Arm shiny is the weapon-and-special slot (1h Blunt / 1h Edged / 2h Blunt / 2h Edged / Assault Rifle / Bow / Break & Entry / Burst / Fling Shot / Full Auto / Grenade / Piercing / Shotgun / Strength / MG-SMG / Heavy Weapons). Pistol is NOT in this list - its shiny home is Right Wrist - and for a Bureaucrat EVERY ranged special here is cost factor 4.0 (Fling Shot, Burst, Full Auto; Aimed Shot 4.0 elsewhere). Break & Entry at cost 2.0 is the cheapest cluster in the list that does anything, and it opens mission doors and containers on a class that solos missions behind its bots. Strength is the alternative if you would rather have the ability.

bright.note: Right Arm bright is Brawling 3.2 / Chemical AC / Physic. Init 2.0 / Swimming 2.0 - nothing a pistol-and-nano Crat uses. Chemical AC is taken for a small armour gain because the Crat never melees; Physic. Init (2.0) is the alternative and is only real on a Martial Arts build (MA is 2.8 for a Crat).

faded.note: Right Arm faded is Fast Attack 4.0 / Mechanical Engineering 1.8 / Parry / Radiation AC / Riposte 3.2. Mechanical Engineering is the cheapest real skill in the list for a Crat and feeds the implant and armour tradeskill chains. Radiation AC is the alternative for armour.

build.notes: Low-priority slot. Nothing here is a Bureaucrat combat skill; the QL can drop first when laddering.

shiny.note: Chest shiny is Body Dev. / Dimach / Energy AC / Max Health / Melee AC / Nano Pool / Sense / Stamina. NANO POOL, not Body Dev. - and this is a deliberate break from the Doctor, Soldier, Engineer and MP builds, which all put Body Dev. here. The numbers: Body Dev. is cost factor 2.4 for a Bureaucrat (1.1 for a Soldier, 2.0 for a Doctor) and Nano Pool is 1.4; the Crat's kit is 343 nanos of chain-cast crowd control, charms that break and have to be re-landed, 25 speeches and 37 pet buffs to keep up, so the nano bar is the fight timer. AOWiki puts it plainly for this class: Nano Pool is the 'buffer for when your Calms go awry', while Body Development 'doesn't necessarily have to be maxed out'. Body Dev. still gets Waist bright + Legs faded.

bright.note: Chest is BM's bright home. BM (cost 1.0) is a requirement on 83 Crat nanos: the entire 9-nano fear line, where PM and BM are equal (Horror From The Darkest Pit 121137 PM 833 / BM 833), the whole 37-nano charm line as the third school (The Voice of God 231010 PM/SI/BM 1500), 12 of the 17 debuffs and all 3 pet repairs. Matter Metamorphosis, Psychic and Projectile AC are the alternatives in this list; MM loses because it is required by ONE nano in 343.

faded.note: Chest is Nano C. Init's faded home and, with Head shiny on PM and Eye bright on SI, its ONLY available home. Cost factor 1.0 and the single most Crat-specific stat in the game - AOWiki: 'Max this out, an extra second or two shaved off that Calm can mean the difference between life and being sent to Reclaim.' Sensory Improvement and Max Nano Energy faded also live here; SI already has Eye bright, and Max Nano Energy loses its last home as a result - see _deviations.

build.notes: Core slot. All three grades do real work: nano bar, the third nano school, and cast speed.

shiny.note: The only Left-Arm-shiny cluster in the game. Cost 3.2 for a Bureaucrat and not a Crat skill - pure filler.

bright.note: Left Arm bright is 2h Blunt / 2h Edged / Bow / Break & Entry / Piercing / Radiation AC / Strength. Every weapon skill in that list is 4.0 for a Crat. Strength is an ability, so it helps meet implant and symbiant ability requirements and carry weight. (Break & Entry took Right Arm shiny already; Radiation AC is the armour alternative.)

faded.note: Left Arm is MM's faded home and, with Head shiny on PM and Chest bright on BM, MM's only available home. Be honest about what it buys: Matter Metamorphosis is a cast requirement on exactly ONE of the Bureaucrat's 343 nanos - Fill Inbox (266303), which needs MM 800 and BM 800. If you never cast it, take Chemical AC or Physic. Init here instead; nothing else in the Crat kit notices. This is the sharpest single difference from the Doctor build, where this same cluster is load-bearing.

build.notes: The least productive slot in the build. Shiny is dead weight and the faded cluster gates one nano.

shiny.note: Right Wrist is Pistol's shiny home. Pistol is cost factor 1.6 and is the Bureaucrat's weapon skill - the class buffs it itself through the PistolBuff line (strain 199): Gunslinger (30077) +20, Pistol Mastery (29246) +40, Skilled Gunslinger (263251) +45 and Greater Gunslinger (263250) +60, the last two needing PM/SI 583. Penultimate Ofab Bureaucrat Gloves (264506) add Pistol +75 at QL300. Ranged Init. (3.2) is the alternative here and loses to Nano C. Init as the initiative that actually matters to a Crat.

bright.note: Right Wrist is the bright home of Burst, Full Auto and Aimed Shot - one only. Burst is named directly by AO-Universe's Bureaucrat guide, which tells a Crat to get 'QL200 implants for Multiranged and Burst skills'. Note the cost: Burst is 4.0 for a Bureaucrat (3.0 for a Doctor, 1.5 for a Soldier), so this cluster is buying a skill the Crat can barely afford with IP - which is exactly why the cluster is worth having. Sneak Attack (2.4) is the cheaper filler; avoid 'Nano AC', which has no confirmed base stat.

faded.note: Right Wrist is Fling Shot's faded home. Fling Shot is the pistol special present on the widest range of pistols and, like every other ranged special, costs a Bureaucrat 4.0. Its shiny home (Right Arm) went to Break & Entry and its bright home (Right Hand) to Time & Space, so this is its only cluster.

build.notes: A real slot for a Crat, unlike the MP build which calls it lowest-priority - but the specials here are all cost-4.0 skills, so on a Crat that never auto-attacks this whole slot is droppable.

shiny.note: Waist shiny is only the four elemental ACs (Chemical / Cold / Fire / Radiation). Pick whichever resist the content you run demands; Cold is a neutral default and is not a sourced choice.

bright.note: Waist is Body Dev.'s bright home and, with Chest shiny spent on Nano Pool, Body Dev.'s best available grade. Max Nano Energy, Max Health, Duck-Exp, Melee AC, Adventuring and Sense are the alternatives; Max Nano Energy loses its last home here, which is defensible because the Ofab and Chosen Crat vests carry it in bulk (Penultimate Ofab Bureaucrat Vest 264518 = Max Nano Energy +900 at QL300, Chosen Bureaucrat Vest 219030 = +800).

faded.note: Waist is BM's faded home - the SECOND BM grade, stacking with the Chest bright. Stamina, Agility, Dodge-Rng, Evade-ClsC, Nano Pool and Duck-Exp faded also live here; a second grade of a 1.0-cost nano school that gates the fear and charm lines beats all of them.

build.notes: Core slot: HP and the second Biological Metamorphosis grade.

shiny.note: Left Wrist shiny is Multi Ranged or Multi Melee only. For most classes this is filler, but AO-Universe's Bureaucrat guide explicitly names it - 'QL200 implants for Multiranged and Burst skills' - because dual-wielding pistols is a standard Crat setup. Multi Ranged is cost 4.0 for a Bureaucrat, so the cluster is doing work IP cannot.

bright.note: Left Wrist bright is Attack Speed / Melee Energy / Parry / Riposte - nothing else a Crat trains. (reference/implants.json flags 'Attack Speed' as an unverified cluster-to-stat mapping; it is taken as the least-useless option, not as a claimed bonus.)

faded.note: Left Wrist faded is Nano AC or Rifle only. Rifle is cost 4.0 and unused; 'Nano AC' has no confirmed base stat in Stat.cs (reference/implants.json flags it), so Rifle is taken purely to avoid asserting a stat that may not exist. Filler either way.

build.notes: Filler on a single-pistol Crat; a real slot (Multi Ranged shiny) on the dual-pistol build AO-Universe describes.

shiny.note: Right Hand shiny is Trap Disarming 2.4 / Martial Arts 2.8 / Weapon Smithing 2.5 - the Bureaucrat's costs make Trap Disarming the cheapest of the three, and it pairs with the Break & Entry cluster at Right Arm shiny for a Crat that solos missions. The Doctor build takes Weapon Smithing here because it is 1.5 for a Doctor; for a Crat it is 2.5. All three are near-filler.

bright.note: Right Hand is Time & Space's bright home and, with Head shiny spent on PM, the best grade T&S can reach. This is the second-most-used school in the whole Bureaucrat kit: 207 of 343 nanos, topping out at 1641 (Puissant Void Inertia 224129). It is required on all 65 robot pets (paired with MC at equal values), all 27 AoE casts, all 17 roots, all 10 snares, all 21 root/snare breakers, all 25 speeches and 36 of the 37 pet buffs - and on 128 nanos where Matter Creation is NOT required at all, which is why it beats MC for this slot. Pistol, First Aid, Matter Creation, Fling Shot and Sharp Objects are the alternatives here and all lose.

faded.note: Right Hand is Treatment's faded home and, with Head shiny on PM and Eye bright on SI, Treatment's only available home. Treatment and Computer Literacy share ALL THREE of those homes, so a Bureaucrat can have exactly one of them from clusters. Treatment wins: it gates the QL of every implant and every Control symbiant the Crat will ever wear (required = trunc(4.7237*QL + 6.7673), about 947 for a QL200 implant), it is cost factor 2.0 for a Crat - twice a Doctor's 1.0 - and AO-Universe's guide says a Crat needs 'QL150 and QL200 treatment implants'. Computer Literacy is cost 1.0, the cheapest skill to simply buy with IP, and it also comes off armour - see _deviations.

build.notes: Core slot. Right Hand bright is the single most contested cluster in a Bureaucrat build: Time & Space, Matter Creation, Pistol and First Aid all live there.

shiny.note: Legs shiny is Agility / Adventuring / Dodge-Rng / Duck-Exp / Projectile AC / Swimming. For a Bureaucrat all three evades cost exactly 2.4 - Dodge-Rng, Duck-Exp and Evade-ClsC are tied, which is not true for a Doctor (2.4/2.4/3.2) or a Soldier (1.5/1.8/2.0) - so the tie-break is stacking, and Dodge-Rng is the one that can take a shiny here AND a bright at Feet. Agility is the alternative if you are short of the ability requirement on a symbiant.

bright.note: Legs bright is Melee Init. / Energy AC / Evade-ClsC / Poison AC / Stamina; taken so Evade-ClsC gets two grades (Feet shiny + here). NOT Stamina, and that is a data call, not a copy of the Doctor build: the Doctor takes Stamina here because Ofab and Chosen Doctor QL300 require Stamina 1099, but the Bureaucrat's own endgame armour carries NO Stamina requirement at all - Ofab Bureaucrat QL300 (264500-264534) requires Intelligence 1045 / Psychic 855 and Chosen/Faithful Bureaucrat QL300 (219024-219050 / 218946-218970) requires Intelligence 1100 / Psychic 900, read from items.ocp. Neither of those abilities has a free cluster home, so neither can be solved here.

faded.note: Legs is Body Dev.'s faded home - the second Body Dev. grade, stacking with the Waist bright. Max Health, Melee AC and Attack Speed faded also live here.

build.notes: Survivability slot. A Crat leans on not being hit (calms, roots, a pet holding aggro) rather than on HP, which is why the evades take two of three grades.

shiny.note: The only Left-Hand-shiny cluster in the game. Cost 4.0 for a Bureaucrat and a melee special a Crat never uses - filler.

bright.note: Left Hand bright is Trap Disarming or Fire AC. Trap Disarming already has Right Hand shiny, so Fire AC takes this for a small armour gain.

faded.note: Left Hand is First Aid's faded home and, with Head shiny on PM and Right Hand bright on Time & Space, its only available home. First Aid is cost 2.0 for a Crat and gates stim QL - and stims are the Bureaucrat's ONLY self-heal: there is no heal nano anywhere in its 343 (the three 'Pet Heals / Repair' nanos, Droid Repair 30072 / Droid Overhaul 30071 / Thorough Overhaul 116798, repair the robot, not the Crat). Ranged Energy and Martial Arts faded also live here.

build.notes: Worn for the faded First Aid cluster - the one that keeps a Crat alive when a calm breaks.

shiny.note: Feet is Evade-ClsC's shiny home; stacks with the Legs bright. Concealment, Melee Init., Physic. Init and Sneak Attack are the alternatives and none of them is a Crat skill.

bright.note: Feet is Dodge-Rng's bright home; stacks with the Legs shiny. Agility and Martial Arts bright also live here.

faded.note: Duck-Exp faded is the ONLY Feet-faded cluster in the game, and with Legs shiny on Dodge-Rng and Waist bright on Body Dev. it is Duck-Exp's only cluster in this build.

build.notes: The evade slot - gives all three evades at least one grade, and two of them a second.

_coverageSummary.SensoryImprovement: Eye bright only (shiny home Head on PM, faded home Chest on Nano C. Init). 153 nanos.
_coverageSummary.TimeAndSpace: Right Hand bright only. 207 nanos - the second-most-required school - but its shiny home is Head (PM) and its faded home is Eye, which it must share with Matter Creation.
_coverageSummary.MatterCreation: Eye faded only. 100 nanos. MC and T&S share all three homes, so one cluster each is the best split possible.
_coverageSummary.BiologicalMetamorphosis: Chest bright + Waist faded - two grades. 83 nanos (fear, charm, debuffs, pet repair).
_coverageSummary.MatterMetamorphosis: Left Arm faded only - and it gates exactly ONE nano in the whole kit (Fill Inbox, 266303, MM 800).
_coverageSummary.NanoCInit: Chest faded only (shiny home Head on PM, bright home Eye on SI). AOWiki's 'max this out' skill for the class.
_coverageSummary.NanoPool: Chest shiny + Head bright - two grades, ahead of Body Dev.
_coverageSummary.Psychology: Ear bright (shiny home Head on PM, faded home Eye on Matter Creation).
_coverageSummary.Treatment: Right Hand faded only - the ladder skill, and cost 2.0 for a Crat.
_coverageSummary.Pistol and specials: Pistol (Right Wrist shiny), Burst (Right Wrist bright), Fling Shot (Right Wrist faded), Multi Ranged (Left Wrist shiny). Every special is cost factor 4.0 for a Bureaucrat.
_coverageSummary.BodyDev: Waist bright + Legs faded (shiny home Chest spent on Nano Pool).
_coverageSummary.Evades: Evade-ClsC (Feet shiny + Legs bright), Dodge-Rng (Legs shiny + Feet bright), Duck-Exp (Feet faded only). All three cost 2.4 for a Crat.

_coverageSummary.NOT IMPLANTED AT ANY GRADE: Computer Literacy, Intelligence, Psychic, Max Nano Energy, Max Health, Nano Programming, Pharma Tech, Stamina, Agility, Ranged Init., Concealment, Martial Arts, Melee Init. and 39 other clusters - 52 of the 85 clusters in the table get nothing. Nano Resist gets nothing because NO Nano Resist cluster exists anywhere in the game. Every one that matters to a Crat is explained in _deviations.

ladder: Treatment is the gate on every implant, and for a Bureaucrat it is cost factor 2.0 - twice a Doctor's - so most of the number has to come from gear and buffs rather than IP. Requirement per implant QL: Treatment = trunc(4.723717064*QL + 6.767295257) (about 947 at QL200) and the governing ability = QL*2 + 4 (about 404 at QL200). Order of work: equip the low-priority slots first (Left Wrist, Left Arm, Right Arm, Ear shiny), stack Treatment and ability buffs, then swap the core caster implants - Head, Eye, Chest, Waist, Right Hand - up one QL step at a time. A Bureaucrat brings almost nothing to its own ladder: it has no self Treatment buff and no self ability buff in its 343 nanos, so the Treatment side comes from a Doctor (Superior First Aid 28675, +80 Treatment), stims, and the Tutoring Device / Nano Crystal ladder items, and the ability side from a Trader wrangle, an Enforcer's Essence, a Composite Attribute Boost and an MP's Composite Mochams. The two abilities to watch are the ones the Crat's OWN endgame armour is gated on and that no cluster in this build supplies: Intelligence 1045 / Psychic 855 for Ofab Bureaucrat QL300 and Intelligence 1100 / Psychic 900 for Chosen/Faithful Bureaucrat QL300. Use Auno Implant Designer / TinkerPlants / AOLadderer to solve the exact sequence. Then plan to throw most of this away: AO-Universe's Bureaucrat guide moves a Crat onto symbiants at level 58 ('especially for your Eye, Head and Right hand') and names Eye, Head, Ear, Chest and Waist as the slots that matter most - at endgame all 13 become Xan Control-unit symbiants (see bureaucrat-symbiants.json), which carry Nano C. Init +275 and are the reason Control beats Extermination for this class.

_validation.method: Script-checked against AOBuddy/GameData/profiles/reference/implants.json. The script reads the 39 placements back out of this file's own build[] array, asserts each cluster name appears in that slot's list for that grade, asserts no cluster appears twice within a single grade, and then derives - from the same table - which clusters get nothing at any grade and which placement took each of their three homes.

_deviations: Head shiny = PSYCHOLOGICAL MODIFICATIONS. The Soldier build spends Head shiny on Matter Creation and the Doctor build on Biological Metamorphosis; for a Bureaucrat neither is close. Counted across all 343 Crat-castable nanos: PM 234, Time & Space 207, Sensory Improvement 153, Matter Creation 100, Biological Metamorphosis 83, Matter Metamorphosis 1. PM is also cost factor 1.0 and tops out at 2001 (Means Test Pet, 258222). Everything else in the Head-shiny list - Computer Literacy, Intelligence, Psychic, Max Nano Energy, Nano Programming, Pharma Tech, Treatment, Nano C. Init, Psychology, SI, MC, T&S, BM, MM - is paying for that one decision.

PM gets shiny + faded, NOT all three grades, and that is deliberate. Its bright home (Eye) goes to SENSORY IMPROVEMENT, because PM and SI are joint requirements at near-identical values on 124 nanos: Empowered Divided Ego (224143) PM 2001 / SI 1997, The Voice of God (231010) PM / SI / BM 1500 each, Demotivational Speech: Dead Man Walking (275826) PM 1913 / SI 1913 / T&S 1471, Greater Corporate Insurance Policy (267605) PM 1901 / SI 1901 / T&S 1401. Raising PM past SI unlocks none of those. This is the opposite call to the Doctor build, which gives BM all three of its grades because BM's requirement is always the HIGHER of its pair.

MATTER CREATION and TIME & SPACE share all three homes (Head shiny, Right Hand bright, Eye faded), so a Bureaucrat can never have both at the same grade - and all 65 of its robot pets require them at EQUAL values (Corporate Guardian 235386: MC 1227 / T&S 1227; CEO Guardian 273300: MC 1470 / T&S 1470), so whichever one you neglect is the one that caps your pet. The split taken here is T&S bright / MC faded, on the ground that T&S is required on 128 nanos where MC is not (every AoE, root, snare, root-breaker, speech and pet buff) while MC is required on only 21 where T&S is not. A pet-first Crat can legally swap them - Right Hand bright = Matter Creation, Eye faded = Time & Space - and should, if the bot is the thing capping out.

MATTER METAMORPHOSIS gets a cluster (Left Arm faded) that buys exactly ONE nano. Fill Inbox (266303) is the only nano in the Bureaucrat's 343 with an MM cast requirement (MM 800 / BM 800). Compare the Doctor file, where MM is a co-requirement on every heal and the same Left Arm faded cluster is called load-bearing, and the Soldier file, where MM is on 36 nanos and gets two grades. For a Crat, Chemical AC or Physic. Init in this slot costs you nothing measurable.

COMPUTER LITERACY gets NO cluster, even though both AOWiki ('Max this out or increase as you find better Belts and NCU') and AO-Universe ('Get as much IP as possible in Computer Litracy untill you can equip QL200 NCUs') tell a Crat to max it. Its three homes are Head shiny (PM), Eye bright (SI) and Right Hand faded, and that last one is shared with Treatment - Treatment and Computer Literacy have IDENTICAL home sets, so a Bureaucrat gets exactly one of the two from clusters. Treatment wins because it gates the QL of the implants and symbiants themselves and costs a Crat 2.0, while Computer Literacy costs 1.0 (the cheapest tier) and also arrives on armour: Chosen/Faithful Bureaucrat Pants (219024 / 218946) give Computer Literacy +30 at QL300.

INTELLIGENCE and PSYCHIC get NO cluster, and for this class that stings more than it does for any other. Intelligence's homes are Head shiny (PM), Eye bright (SI) and Ear faded (PM); Psychic's are Head shiny (PM), Chest bright (BM) and Ear faded (PM). Both are the Bureaucrat's primary abilities - AO-Universe: 'Primary abilities is Stamina, Intelligence and Psychic' - and, read from items.ocp, they are the ONLY requirements on the Crat's own endgame armour: Ofab Bureaucrat QL300 needs Intelligence 1045 / Psychic 855 and Chosen/Faithful Bureaucrat QL300 needs Intelligence 1100 / Psychic 900. That has to come from symbiants, the armour itself (Penultimate Ofab Bureaucrat Headgear 264500 gives Intelligence +32, OFAB Bureaucrat Protective Gear 267932 gives Psychic +25, Chosen Bureaucrat Cloak 219050 gives Psychic +20) and the Genius perk line - never from a cluster.

MAX NANO ENERGY gets NO cluster, the opposite of the Doctor build, which takes it at Waist bright. Its homes are Head shiny (PM), Chest faded (Nano C. Init) and Waist bright (Body Dev.). Giving it up is defensible for this class specifically because the Crat's own armour carries it in bulk: Penultimate Ofab Bureaucrat Vest (264518) gives Max Nano Energy +900 at QL300, the plain Ofab Vest (264522) +750, Chosen Bureaucrat Vest (219030) +800 and Special Edition Ofab Bureaucrat Headgear (267364) +500 - and Nano Pool, the skill that scales the pool, already has two grades.

Chest shiny = NANO POOL, not Body Dev. Every other class file done so far (MP, Soldier, Engineer, Doctor) puts Body Dev. in Chest shiny. The Bureaucrat's Body Dev. cost factor is 2.4 - the joint most expensive of any class profiled (Soldier 1.1, Enforcer 1.0, Doctor 2.0) - and its Nano Pool is 1.4, and AOWiki's Crat page says Body Development 'doesn't necessarily have to be maxed out' while Nano Pool is the 'buffer for when your Calms go awry'. Body Dev. still takes Waist bright + Legs faded, so it gets two grades, just not the big one.

Legs bright = EVADE-CLSC, not Stamina. The Doctor build takes Stamina there because Ofab/Chosen Doctor QL300 requires Stamina 1099. The equivalent read for this class says the opposite: Ofab Bureaucrat and Chosen/Faithful Bureaucrat QL300 have NO Stamina requirement at all (Intelligence and Psychic only), so there is no gear reason to buy Stamina with a cluster. All three Crat evades also cost exactly 2.4, which is unusual - for a Doctor Evade-ClsC is 3.2 and for a Soldier 2.0 - so the evade picks are decided purely by which pairs of homes are free, giving Dodge-Rng and Evade-ClsC two grades each and Duck-Exp one.

The pistol specials are priced completely differently for a Crat and this changes the weapon slots. Fling Shot, Burst, Full Auto and Aimed Shot are ALL cost factor 4.0 for a Bureaucrat, against Fling Shot 2.4 / Burst 3.0 for a Doctor and Fling Shot 1.0 / Burst 1.5 / Full Auto 1.5 for a Soldier. So Right Arm shiny is NOT given to Fling Shot the way the Doctor build gives it - it goes to Break & Entry (cost 2.0, the cheapest cluster in that list that does anything for a mission-running class) - and the specials that are kept (Burst at Right Wrist bright, Fling Shot at Right Wrist faded) are kept precisely because IP cannot realistically buy them.

Left Wrist shiny = MULTI RANGED is a real pick here, not filler. Both the MP and Doctor files write this slot off; AO-Universe's Bureaucrat guide names it directly ('QL200 implants for Multiranged and Burst skills') because dual-wielding pistols is a standard Crat setup, and Multi Ranged is cost 4.0 for a Bureaucrat so the cluster is doing work IP cannot.

Eye shiny = TUTORING, where the Doctor build takes Electrical Engineering and the Soldier takes Aimed Shot. The Eye-shiny list is useless to a Crat either way, so the pick is decided by cost: Tutoring is 1.0 for a Bureaucrat and Electrical Engineering is 2.4 (for a Doctor those are 1.0 and 1.6, which is why that file could justify EE). Same reasoning at Right Hand shiny: Trap Disarming (2.4) over Weapon Smithing (2.5) and Martial Arts (2.8), where the Doctor takes Weapon Smithing at 1.5.

Ear bright = PSYCHOLOGY as a real skill, not as cheap filler. The Doctor and Soldier files both take Psychology here and both call it 'the cheapest filler in a useless list'. For a Bureaucrat it is cost factor 1.0, AOWiki says 'Max this out if you plan on using Charms extensively', and the Crat is the only profession with a self-cast Psychology buff line (Authority Figure 30057 +50, Improved Authority Figure 207284 +52, both needing only PM/SI 207) plus +60 more from the Chosen/Faithful Bureaucrat Cloak (219050 / 218970). This is the same cluster in the same slot meaning something completely different.

First Aid at Left Hand faded is not a convenience cluster for this class, it is the whole self-heal. The Bureaucrat has NO heal nano anywhere in its 343: the three nanos filed under 'Pet Heals / Repair' (Droid Repair 30072, Droid Overhaul 30071, Thorough Overhaul 116798) all repair the robot. Stims are it, and First Aid gates their QL.

No Bureaucrat-specific per-slot implant sheet was located: AO-Universe's Bureaucrat guide gives only level milestones and two named skills (Multiranged and Burst at QL200, 'QL150 and QL200 treatment implants'), AOWiki's Bureaucrat:Breed_and_Skills gives per-skill advice but no shiny/bright/faded layout, and auno.org / aoitems.com / anarchyonline.fandom.com block automation (playbook section 4), so nothing was relayed from them. This layout is therefore DERIVED - from reference/implants.json (legality), reference/skillcaps.json (Bureaucrat cost factors) and bureaucrat-nanos.json (cast requirements) - not copied from a guide.

Cluster bonus magnitudes per grade (the actual +skill number a shiny/bright/faded cluster gives at a given QL) are not in reference/implants.json beyond the ~60% / ~40% ratios, so no numeric skill gain is claimed anywhere in this file.

reference/implants.json itself flags three cluster-to-stat mappings that this build touches: 'Attack Speed' (taken at Left Wrist bright - taken as least-useless filler, no bonus claimed), 'Nano AC' (no base stat exists in Stat.cs - deliberately AVOIDED, Rifle taken instead at Left Wrist faded), and 'Time & Space' (sourceName MaterialLocation). The Time & Space mapping is load-bearing here; it matches the SpaceTime stat id 131 used in the Bureaucrat cast requirements, but the cluster-name-to-stat join was not independently re-verified against client data in this pass.
Which elemental AC to put in Waist shiny (Cold AC here) is content-dependent and unsourced - an arbitrary neutral default.

Psychology is stated as the skill the charm nanos are checked against. That is the standard AO understanding and AOWiki's Bureaucrat page ties Psychology to charms explicitly ('Max this out if you plan on using Charms extensively'), but no Psychology requirement appears in the charm nanos' own castReqs in bureaucrat-nanos.json - the 37 charms check PM / SI / BM. If Psychology's charm role is a server-side check rather than a cast requirement, this cluster is justified by the buff line and the Cloak bonus alone, not by a cast gate.

The alternative picks named in several slots (Strength instead of Break & Entry at Right Arm shiny, Physic. Init instead of Chemical AC at Right Arm bright, Agility instead of Dodge-Rng at Legs shiny, the pet-first MC/T&S swap at Right Hand bright and Eye faded) are stated as legal options, not as tested builds.
Which slots an endgame Crat keeps as implants rather than Control symbiants depends on the symbiants owned; that tradeoff is qualitative here and modelled properly in bureaucrat-symbiants.json.

The laddering buffs named (Doctor's Superior First Aid 28675 for Treatment, Trader wrangle, Enforcer Essence, Composite Attribute Boost, MP Composite Mochams, Genius perk line) are general AO buffs from other professions' files and general knowledge, not re-verified against the Bureaucrat data in this pass. The claim that the Bureaucrat has no self Treatment or self ability buff IS verified - no such nano appears in its 343.
